World-Class Infrastructure

Campus Facilities

Engineered to Support Academic Exploration, Athletics, and Safety

Smart 4K Classrooms

Acoustically treated, climate-controlled rooms with digital interactive panels, high-definition audio, and ergonomic modular furniture.

Robotics & AI Innovation Hub

Cutting-edge makerspace stocked with Arduino, Raspberry Pi, 3D printers, Python workstations, and drone prototyping kits.

Knowledge Center & Library

Over 35,000 physical titles, national periodicals, digital e-book terminals, and quiet study carrels for senior researchers.

Multi-Sport Arena & Pool

Full-size football turf, indoor wooden badminton courts, synthetic basketball courts, and temperature-controlled swimming pool.

Advanced Science Laboratories

Dedicated Physics, Chemistry, and Biology laboratories built according to strict CBSE and international safety benchmarks.

Smart GPS Transport Fleet

Fleet of 40+ air-conditioned buses featuring live GPS vehicle tracking, speed governors, onboard female attendants, and CCTV.
